preconditions.description: The input contains a single integer n between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly two nonempty strings separated by a single space.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() for c in s) and all(c.isalpha() for c in p)
postconditions.description: Both output strings s and p consist only of letters (a-z, A-Z).
Both output strings s and p have lengths between 1 and 200 inclusive.
The number of occurrences of p as a subsequence in s is exactly n, where subsequence_count counts the number of distinct index sets in s that form p in order.
